processing: Leading silence trimmed, 2 ms fade in, fade out, levelled to a shared loudness with peaks at or under -1 dBFS. starts_at_ms is where the decoded file first passes -30 dB of its peak, attack_ms where it first passes -12 dB.
note: MP3 encoders pad the start of a file. Decoders that read the LAME header (Chrome, Firefox, ffmpeg) skip the padding, which is how these numbers were measured; one that does not would start about 25 ms later.

sounds.name: woodblock
sounds.use: One beat on the trace, and the metronome.
sounds.prompt: A single dry woodblock hit. One short percussive wooden tick, close microphone, clean, no reverb, no echo, nothing else.

sounds.name: tuba
sounds.prompt: Tuba playing one short, fat, very low staccato note, a single oom, brass bass sample, dry, close.

sounds.name: sour
sounds.prompt: Tuba playing one short wrong note that bends downward and wilts, pitch sliding down like it is deflating, comedic brass blooper, solo, dry.

sounds.name: whistle
sounds.prompt: One upward glissando on a slide whistle, low to high in half a second, solo, dry, no reverb.

sounds.name: flatline
sounds.prompt: A steady, continuous electronic tone at one constant pitch, a single unbroken high beep that does not change, like a monitor holding one note. No pulses, no other sound.

sounds.name: trombone
sounds.use: After the flatline tone, on an arrest.
sounds.prompt: A slow sad trombone, comedic: three descending notes and then one long drooping last note, wah wah wah waaah. Solo trombone, dry, no audience, no other instruments.

sounds.name: balloon
sounds.prompt: A rubber balloon being let go: air squealing and sputtering out as it flies away and deflates for about one and a half seconds, then a short silence, then a single clear triangle ding.

sounds.name: fanfare
sounds.prompt: A kazoo plays ta-da: one short note, then a second, higher, longer note. Two notes only, bright and proud, solo kazoo, dry.
sounds.assembled: The generator would not play a tune, only held notes. This call is four notes cut from the one generated kazoo note of take 7 and re-pitched to a rising major arpeggio (ratios 1, 5/4, 3/2, 2), 150 ms apart, the last one held. The 150 ms spacing is a quarter of a 600 ms block.
